recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. Broader questions about Resource.id optionality or server assignment should be handled as separate, later issues, not as a reopening of this DSTU1 restoration request.
issue_request: FHIR-3558 is a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core change request asking to restore the logical id inside every resource instead of treating it only as external metadata, represented as XML <id value="[logical-id]"/> and JSON "id": "logical-id", generally present except for create contexts.
initial_application: The Jira comments say the issue was done as part of task 3728. FHIR-3728 is the broader Published/Persuasive Atom replacement issue, and git commit 80fbeea24661109910d9da7ed435a444b9879846 added Resource.id as a 0..1 id element in the Resource spreadsheet and added an id to the Resource example. The 2021 core source rework moved the base Resource definition into source/resource/structuredefinition-Resource.xml while preserving Resource.id.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini keeps resource=abstract,Resource under [resource-infrastructure], so the base Resource definition is in current build scope. Current source defines Resource.id, the Resource Identity narrative says each resource has an id element with expected exceptions, and XML format guidance explicitly says the resource id is an element rather than an XML attribute. Exact Zulip and Confluence searches for FHIR-3558 found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current build inputs already implement the requested rule and are not misleading. Additional prose would duplicate existing Resource Identity and XML-format guidance without changing implementer understanding.
